liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Uncle John's Band** (2 reviews): Final Uncle John's jam stretches and turns into a free-form, exploratory jam among Phil, Jerry, Mickey and Billy, with Jerry trying synth patches; The jam coming out of Uncle John's Band is singled out as awesome, along with Phil's spoken blessing [10][17]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer cites Deal as an example of Jerry's 1993 playing: unusual chord connections and shorter phrasing [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Pre-drum space jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd93-12-18.aud.vernon.7277.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 176 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [1]
- **gd1993-12-18.168893.nyquist.omnis.hunt.ont.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 169 min [2]
- **gd93-12-18.sbd.ladner.20330.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 162 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has a mellow, well-balanced mix with the keyboards notably forward; The soundboard transfer is crystal clear, much better than the reviewer's old radio-taped copy [7][8]
- **gd1993-12-18.141525.FOB-km140.ebel.flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- Jerry's voice had some trouble, though he still sang acceptably and his playing was especially sharp [10]
- Crowd noise at the tape's end captures the taper chatting with friends in a different spot from Dom [15]
- Crowd was upbeat with a great vibe; the reviewer recalls riding BART home at midnight after Coliseum shows [16]
- Uploader first saw a Sony TCD-D7 DAT recorder at this show [2]
- Reviewer suggests the 9/13/93 show is the year's best by far, implying this one is lesser [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-12-18.aud.vernon.7277.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Audience: probably Neumann KM140's [1]. Also: Taped by Keith Litzenberger with Schoeps MK4 microphones, Reutelhuber preamp, and Sony TCD-D10PROII DAT recorder; Source is an unknown front-of-board audience tape, likely Neumann KM-140 microphones, passed through DAT generations to CDR [1][15]
- **gd1993-12-18.168893.nyquist.omnis.hunt.ont.flac16**: taped by Jack Hunt; transferred by OldNeumanntapr; source: FOB; Nyquist Omnis >Sony TCD-D3 DAT [2]. Also: Uploader recorded with Nakamichi CM 300s into a D5 from the tapers section; friend Jack taped up front [2]
- **gd93-12-18.sbd.ladner.20330.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jim Powell and Chris Ladner; source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd1993-12-18.141525.FOB-km140.ebel.flac1648**: taped by Possibly Dominic Tringale; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/48 Source Info: FOB Neumann KM140-> DATPossibly recorded by Dominic Tringale.Transfer Info: DAT Tape (Panasonic SV-3700) -> Coxial SPDIF-> Marantz PMD… [3]
